title: A separate search finds no extra dip above a score of eight in Kepler data for KIC 11084727
abstract: We search Kepler release 25 quarters 0 to 17 for additional dips on KIC 11084727. A separate masked-profile implementation recovers the known event and finds no extra event above its stated score threshold. Three profile widths and three depths are tested with artificial signals added before median baseline removal. Direct sums and full-quarter calculations check the local implementation. The result supports earlier signed campaign searches. It is a software replication, not a new object or independent telescope evidence. The scores have no calibrated false-alarm probability. Shape selection, a nominal time grid, one star, and injection after pipeline correction limit the inference. We report no event rate. The package includes code, derived flux, complete scan and injection tables, source hashes, and retrieval instructions.
